QuestInfo.name: One Who Sees Darkness
QuestInfo.0: Grendel probably knows what eyes that see darkness are.
QuestInfo.1: #bDouble-click on the #i2430873# Vampiric Lantern#k to get to the Giant Tree and #beliminate 50 Evil Eyes#k. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to return when all's said and done.
QuestInfo.2: You've gathered all four paradoxes in the Vampiric Lantern.\r\n#r* You need to reach Lv. 28 to proceed to the next quest.#k\r\n

0.0: Let's cut to the chase, eyes that see darkness probably means those that see brighter light in darkness. Perhaps you have such a power... \r\n#L0##bWhy are you looking at me like that? It's not at all pleasant.#l\n#k
0.1: No, no. I think it's Evil Eyes. Evil Eyes used to hide in the deep ends of caves, and they evolved so their sight is much better in darkness than in light.

yes.0: You have to hunt #b50 monsters#k again. You know how to return, right?

no.0: This is the last task, remember?

1.0: And that's your last paradox. I believe our business is done.

yes.0: I can't tell you how happy I am to see you go!\r\n#r* You need to reach Lv. 28 to proceed to the next quest.#k\r\n

mob.0: They are known for their large eyes. It's quite unusual for monsters that live in the darkness for years and years. They can see much light, because they reside in darkness...
